display.purpose: Page titles and modal headings. Two per view maximum.

body.purpose: All body copy and data content. 65–75ch on reading surfaces.

label.purpose: Form labels, column headers, nav section labels. Only uppercase context.

mono.purpose: OTP codes, PIN inputs, dev hints, code values.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting state for interactive cards — separates surface from background.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Card hover state (paired with translateY(-3px), 250ms ease-out). Signals actionability.

shadows.name: dominant
shadows.purpose: Modals only. Paired with backdrop-filter: blur(4px). Signals shared-flow pause.

shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Primary button only. One per view. The brand glow; its rarity is the signal.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions: color, opacity, border changes.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entering elements: modals, toasts, row reveals.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Exiting elements: modal dismiss, row removal.

motion.name: duration-quick
motion.purpose: Card hover lift, nav active state.

motion.name: duration-long
motion.purpose: Completion moments. Maximum for any UI animation.

motion.name: duration-row-stagger-step
motion.purpose: Per-row stagger delay step for table row reveals.

narrative.overview:
Together is designed for exactly two people who know each other. The relationship is not the theme of this app — it is a first-class object in the data model and in the design. Every surface asks: does this make the partnership more visible and more felt? Not 'is this productive?' but 'does this feel accompanied?'

The visual system is warm and certain. The primary red is committed and specific — the color of the heart in the logo, the color of an action that matters to both of you, never an error color. The dark foundation grounds the sidebar and frame, lending reliability without coldness. Core surfaces stay calm; delight is concentrated into three bounded categories and does not leak into ambient decoration.

The signature gesture — dual-presence — is structurally impossible to copy in a single-user app. The partner's online state and live actions are visible across surfaces. That is the 'two of us' — not a theme, not a color scheme, but a design primitive.
keyCharacteristics: One Pompeii Crimson accent per view — its rarity is the signal
Flat at rest; lift reserved for interactive or live-shared state
Dual-presence as a first-class design element
Craft-delight bounded to three categories only
All color values are tokens; inline style attributes are findings to eliminate

rules.name: The Token Law
rules.body: Every color value is a token class. Inline style={{ background }} attributes are forbidden. The @theme inline block in globals.css is the single source of truth.

rules.name: The One Crimson Rule
rules.body: Pompeii Crimson marks exactly one primary action per view. Two crimsons means broken hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: New components ship without shadow. Shadow is earned by a specific interactive state, not applied for polish.

rules.name: The One Modal Rule
rules.body: At most one element carries Dominant shadow at a time. No nested modals.

rules.name: The One-Glow Rule
rules.body: One primary button means one glow per view. The glow's rarity is its meaning.

rules.name: The Weight-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight and scale, not color. Never color text to indicate heading level.

dos: Define every color in globals.css @theme inline. Use bg-cr, text-sl-muted, bg-cm-pale everywhere.
Use Pompeii Crimson for exactly one primary action per view.
Show partner presence on every interactive surface where it is meaningful.
Keep the delight inventory to three categories: completion moments, presence transitions, considered empty states.
Write empty states that feel personal — acknowledge the partnership, not the empty database.
Provide @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives for every animation.
Verify contrast before every ship: body text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1.
donts: Don't use inline style={{ background: '#C0392B' }} or any inline color value. Every inline color is a violation.
Don't use #E8D5B7 or any warm cream/sand as a surface tint. Use cm (#F2EAE3) or cm-pale (#FAF8F6) instead.
Don't place two primary buttons (two glows) on the same screen.
Don't add gamification: no streaks, no confetti, no progress rings, no nagging copy.
Don't use dating-app warmth: no floating hearts, no pink washes, no gradient fills, no swipe gestures.
Don't use cold enterprise SaaS patterns: not Jira blue as brand, not information-dense tables without breathing room.
Don't place a nested card. Refactor to flat row list or inline content block.
Don't add shadow to a new component without a named reason tied to interactive state.
Don't use border-left > 1px as a colored accent stripe. Use a background tint or leading icon instead.
